basic_info.description: Welcome to 129 Joost Ave  a bright, beautifully updated 3BD/2BA home offering modern comfort, stunning views, and an unbeatable location on the border of Glen Park and Sunnyside. The open-concept layout features a sunlit living room, stylish dining area, and a renovated kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample storage. Enjoy indoor-outdoor living with access to a large view deck and a professionally landscaped south-facing yard with turf, fruit trees, and a patio. The middle-level primary suite boasts dual closets, a spa-like bath, and private deck. A lower-level family room offers flexible use as an office, guest space, or game room. Wide-plank floors, EV charging, garage parking, and abundant storage complete the home. Just blocks to BART, freeways, tech shuttles, shops, parks, and trails  this home is move-in ready and perfectly situated for city living.
